Package io.jans.scim.model.scim2.provider.resourcetypes

Class ResourceType

java.lang.Object
io.jans.scim.model.scim2.BaseScimResource
io.jans.scim.model.scim2.provider.resourcetypes.ResourceType
public class ResourceType extends BaseScimResource
This class is used to specify metadata about a resource type. It's the key class for representing the output of the /ResourceTypes endpoint. For more about this resource type see RFC 7643, section 6.
